status: G2 isolated system-keyboard lifecycle and native draft proved; retained previews unchanged

design.preferred: LG system keyboard for language/input integration; Luma owns and natively renders the field, filtering and drawer
design.fallback: Luma alphanumeric keypad when the system keyboard is unavailable or explicitly selected; never revealed just because LG dismissed its panel
design.dismissal: Done or Back finishes editing, retains the committed query and restores focus to Search
design.delivery_boundary: The normal G2 0.21.0 and C2 0.20.0 previews still use the existing Luma keypad. This milestone does not promote system-keyboard mode into the retained preview.

shared_framework: grapheme-aware TextBuffer navigation/deletion and transactional bounded commits
clipped TextEntry with native caret and separate preedit run
luma: 256-byte owned draft; NFC-normalized matching with lowercase tokens
typed C SDL event adapter; complete commit boundaries; text payload excluded from event serialization
system-keyboard ownership suppresses fallback drawing and its input targets
panel state is observed only after activation; an initial absent flag does not cancel opening
leaving Apps ends editing; late text cannot alter a hidden drawer
implementation.attribution: Framework modifications stay in the explicitly attributed PlxNative integration patch; no Plex client or player features are included.

verification.firmware_symbol_inventory: all 14 inventories pass loader resolution; releases >=9.2.0 are the release gate, not behavioural qualification

automated_g2.dismissal_input: Two test-harness Back presses, each guarded by own foreground card and independently observed LG keyboard window
automated_g2.native_frame_review: Accented query, native field, logo/rail and closed second-cycle frame reviewed; closed frame has Search focused and no keypad

physical_g2.human_report: Both worked: Magic Remote typing, Done, reopening, typing and Back
physical_g2.back_observation: LG hid its keyboard and did not forward a Back key to the app. The initial build consequently revealed the still-active Luma keypad; this prompted the ownership/dismissal fix.
physical_g2.manual_harness_limit: The first manual run completed its two editing stages but failed to produce its terminal exit/storage receipt. An additional harness Back was sent only after LG keyboard absence was verified; the isolated package was then removed and independent state checks passed. Do not count that run as a complete automatic lifecycle pass.
physical_g2.corrected_followup: The corrected lifecycle was verified by the separate two-cycle automated G2 trial above; no second human test is claimed.

compatibility_findings: A focused window flag does not establish that SDL startup/Wayland events have been pumped. Activation succeeded after draining startup events before SDL_StartTextInput.
The webOS text-event layout differs from desktop SDL. SDK-typed decoding and actual device export/layout inspection were used; host synthetic SDL text pushes are not used.
LG panel dismissal can leave SDL text input active until the app calls SDL_StopTextInput. The corrected trial observes the hide and stops its own request.
An SDL panel flag alone is not visibility proof; the separate surface-manager window audit establishes panel presence/absence in this trial.
remaining: Integrate the validated system-keyboard request into normal search with explicit fallback selection and compatibility gates.
Verify prediction semantics, preedit/caret positioning, hardware keyboard, deletion and long-query rendering under actual workloads.
Qualify additional languages/fonts and RTL shaping separately; NFC matching is not full Unicode case folding.
Independently qualify C2 system-keyboard behaviour and normal lifecycle, then measure performance; these G2 results do not establish either.
